description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). IMPORTANT — measure in a coverage-free environment: complexFunctions/criticalComplexity are CRAP-based and CRAP depends on coverage. fallow auto-ingests a local istanbul `coverage/coverage-final.json` (gitignored, absent in CI's fresh checkout), which drops these to ~76/0 via the `istanbul` model; CI has no coverage report so fallow uses the `static_estimated` model and measures 231/1. This baseline is pinned to the CI-true static_estimated numbers. To reproduce CI locally, run `rm -rf coverage .fallow && npm run check:quality` (or measure in a fresh `git clone`); a run with `coverage/` present will report lower values and pass as an unlocked improvement.
